title: 3F MushYO
features:
🔥3F STALKER — Complete Panel for Roblox

✨Best Features:

🎯Complete Target System—select players and use quick functions in real time.

👥Friend Scanner—find friends on the server with an organized interface.

🧾Profile Plus—view player information, UserID, avatar, friends, and quick actions.

🚨Blacklist/Radar—save targets and receive alerts when they are on the same server.

🌐Presence System—shows active users, global status, and server information.

🎨Premium Themes—Default, Blackout, Death Note, Cyber ​​Pulse, and Sakura Rose.

📱Optimized Mobile Mode—floating button, adapted interface, and visual boost.

⚡Customizable Hotkeys—configure shortcuts for important functions.

💾Saved Settings—theme, language, button position, hotkeys, and preferences.

🛰️ Ping System — mark locations as danger, target, safe, come and look.

🎙️ Voice Status — status panel and alert related to the microphone/voice.

🛡️ ​​Panic Button — quickly and safely terminate functions.

🌎 Multi-language — Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

🚀 Modern, lightweight, and optimized interface — premium look with smooth animations.

💜 A complete, beautiful, and functional panel for those who want practicality, style, and control all in one place.
